trevor-sales: add `claim_timestamp` so we can sort collisions.

comm-bot: calendar: "SI marketplace intake" Wed 10:00am PT 1 attendees monica-partners, trevor-sales, yuki-solutions, sam-hw.
monica-partners: action items: trevor = sweep + CSV upload, sam = SKU list, yuki = demo rotation plan. i'll draft ROE doc and loop legal if needed. :thumbsup:
